prompts.instruments:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready transparent 2D side-view videogame sprite atlas for the original science-fiction game ORDRE DE CENDRE. Create exactly 8 isolated sprites in a strict 4 column by 2 row grid on a 1536 by 1024 canvas. Every cell is 384 by 512; all sprites fully inside their cell, 28 pixel transparent gutters, same orthographic side view and consistent scale within each row. No cell borders, no captions, no letters, no numerals, no watermark, no background, no floor, no cast shadow outside objects.
Style: detailed hand-painted military science fiction, matte worn olive/sage steel, tarnished brass fittings, restrained pale mint instrument illumination, fine mechanical joints, readable at small game size. Match a grounded industrial world in a humid forest. Objects are devices, not people or robots.
Top row left to right: four states of the SAME ground vibration listening station, a compact angled instrument head on a sturdy two-legged stand with a connected probe reaching the ground on its left and a low wide footing. State1 idle: subdued waveform display and shut access cover. State2 listening: brighter waveform display, small mechanical acquisition indicator, same silhouette. State3 recorded: secure latched memory bay with steady pale indicator, same device. State4 lost: cracked dark display, bent stand and broken probe still physically lying against its base, no fire or smoke.
Bottom row left to right: four states of the SAME imperial translation receiver, a squat slanted rectangular console on a heavy pedestal, broad readable screen, side cable socket, metal hood, ground footing. State1 untranslated: dim block-like abstract display with NO text. State2 copying: luminous abstract horizontal signal bars, same silhouette. State3 copied: latched cassette bay and steady pale indicator, same silhouette. State4 lost: broken dark screen and split hood with all fragments clustered around its attached pedestal, no smoke.
Keep the baseline of all objects on each row identical; floor contact at 460px within each cell, entire silhouette around 300px wide and 380px tall. In every state keep identifiable physical construction, disconnected objects do not float. Genuine RGBA transparency.
prompts.terrain-sites:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready transparent 2D side-view atlas for the original science-fiction game ORDRE DE CENDRE. Exactly8 isolated wide low environment sprites in a strict2 columns by4 rows grid on a1536x1024 canvas; cells768x256. Every silhouette stays within its own cell, about640px wide, max180px high, flat contact baseline at218px. Orthographic side view, consistent scale within each family. No border, caption, lettering, numbers, watermark, background, distant landscape or rectangular ground slab. True alpha transparency.
Style: intricate hand-painted grounded alien forest life, humid moss, brown-violet woody fibers, sage greens and pale ivory shells; visible roots and load-bearing wood, natural subdued highlights, detailed but strong silhouettes.
First two rows, four states of ONE local nesting site (row1col1 intact, row1col2 disturbed, row2col1 damaged, row2col2 lost). Wide shallow woven root nest firmly attached to a low mossy mound, with four large asymmetrical ribbed pale egg-like pods nestled among the roots. Intact: all four closed. Disturbed: same closed pods and footprint, roots/leaves shifted, no cartoon motion lines or extra animals. Damaged: one pod cracked and part of nest splintered, other three intact. Lost: all four are empty broken shells and collapsed weave, no creatures, no blood, no fire, no smoke. The sprites represent sites, not a population count.
Last two rows, four states of ONE broad low arched root passage landmark (row3col1 unknown, row3col2 surveyed, row4col1 damaged, row4col2 destroyed). A strong continuous woody root arch with two ground-contact ends, shallow open space beneath, roughlysame640x170 silhouette. Unknown: natural intact root arch. Surveyed: same root with two small survey stakes securely planted at the two ends, each carrying one plain muted ochre cloth flag, no writing. Damaged: same arch with clear stress split and stripped bark around center, still connected. Destroyed: broken arch collapsed into low splintered center between original end stumps, clear discontinuity, no artificial bridge or metal deck. Do not include a walkable path extending beyond the cell. Keep contact baseline consistent, destroyed state shorter. No baked shadows outside silhouette.
